title: Repeat with loops
intro: Typing the same thing again and again is boring. A loop repeats instructions for you.
`for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++)` runs the lines between the braces 8 times, while `i` counts 0, 1, 2, 3 and so on. Here `scale[i]` picks the i-th note from the list.
task: Play the scale, then make it faster or slower by changing 0.3.
hint: Try `i * 0.15` for a faster scale. Add 'D5' and 'E5' to the list and listen to what changes.
